purpose: VAD-trimmed control for the codec slice (pre-registered in README)
one_file_per_original_and_codec: lowest file ID if several quality levels
trimming: leading and trailing silence only (start of first to end of last speech segment); each file trimmed independently; same settings for bona fide and spoof
no_speech_found: file kept untrimmed and flagged in the trim log
model_input_after_trim: same as before: first 64,600 samples, short clips repeated
vad_frame: 512 samples = 32 ms at 16 kHz, non-overlapping (silero-vad default window_size_samples); boundaries fall on this grid, then speech_pad_ms=30 is applied, so trims are n*32 ms - 30 ms
